scientific_conclusion: The retained CCFT mathematics supports five lineage-specific numerical or phenomenological operational surrogates, but no object has a complete source-bound physical bearer, units, mesoscopic scale, laboratory operation, and measurement map. The shared zero-coupling wave behavior and five diagnostic or limiting records reduce to generic or known-physics structures. Potentially distinctive content remains in nonlinear, UCFF, rotor-curvature, chi, or scale-transition terms, but those terms are bounded surrogates, blocked, or conflicting rather than physically operational CCFT quantities.
